summary: The right rights, set by the update itself.

fixes.title: Exactly the rights each part needs
fixes.text: Unused rights are removed, rare ones are given only on demand, and the needed ones are set up and read back.

fixes.title: The web app reads no Azure details
fixes.text: The System Documentation's facts come from the update, so the web app needs no read right on your resources.

fixes.title: Settings change only through the update
fixes.text: A value set on the update job is applied, read back and recorded by the update itself.
